main_text.l: tionem, scribens ad potentissimum quendam Principem. Circuit jam Christus esuriens, sitiens, nudus, vinctus, conquerens de Antichristi Romani rabie, de quorundam impiorum Regum injustissima asperitate & saevitia, petens ne lacerentur crudeliter membra sui corporis, sed ut vulnera faucii & spoliati viatoris, Luc. x. Salutaribus remediis sanentur, & concordia pia consensuque Christiano, moderatis consiliis, & legitimis modis satiatur, defendanturque vera Ecclesia, & ornetur Evangelium, hunc Angelum magni Consilii, & aeterni Patris summum veracissimumque Legatum, pie agnoscere, reverenter excipere, benigne fovere, magni, potentis, & vere pii Principis est officium, & cultus Deo gratissimus, valeat Vestra Celsitudo Densque Opt. Max. eam quam diutissime florentem conservet.

page.notes: Scan is a little blurred in the running head and the date line; the printed Roman numerals are given as read. The text contains a mixed-type Greek-free run of italic words; "Densque" and "Angelum" are doubtful readings of the damaged italic type.
